components.title: Vocabulary Flashcards
components.subtitle: Flip each card to reveal definitions and build your active vocabulary.

cards.back: Lasting for a very short time.
The occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.
(Of a voice or words) sweet or musical; pleasant to hear.
A pleasant smell that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather.
Denoting a period of time in the past that was idyllically happy and peaceful.
The dawn or natural electrical phenomenon characterized by the appearance of streamers of reddish or greenish light in the sky.
An solution or remedy for all difficulties or diseases.
The state or situation of being alone, often providing peace and reflection.
Full of or shedding light; bright or shining, especially in the dark.
The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.
